Why bridges

You will learn

Why a design grows more than one bus, and what the bridge spec checks of its own state.

A design grows more than one bus because peripherals andcompute differ: a slow register bus for the knobs, a wide one for the data. The bridge spec, FPGA_Bridge, is the crossing of this design, and bridge_initially_idle and bridge_rx_buffers_empty are two of its twenty-one tests. The recording runs t27c check: 0 errors, 0 warnings.

Try it

In the recording, find the error and warning counts; then in the spec frame find the two idle tests and count the spec's tests.
